name: neo-extension
description: Neo — Advanced Monitoring & Control Chrome Extension
author: Dr. Y_MC

scripts.build:wasm: cd neo-core && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../neo-ui/src/wasm --out-name neo_core
scripts.build:all: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ui && npm run build:bridge && npm run post:build
scripts.clean: npx --yes rimraf dist neo-ui/dist neo-core/pkg neo-ui/src/wasm && npm run clean:src-js
scripts.clean:hard: npm run clean && npx --yes rimraf node_modules neo-ui/node_modules neo-bridge/node_modules package-lock.json
